scientific_integrity: Logspace algorithm proved by parity of edge traversals and repeated deterministic logspace free-group word equality; exact finite checks are supporting, not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite inverse-generating alphabet; standard generators only. The bound is an upper bound, not logspace-hardness. Strict non-context-free/co-context-free statements for rank at least 2 are cited from prior work. Indexed-language status and other generators remain open. Historical priority qualified due to a short synthesis of prior Munn-tree and group word-problem facts. Independent validation not performed.
title: Deterministic logspace recognition of Green-geodesic languages of free inverse monoids
